crossRefs.note: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

translations.web: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.
translations.bsb: Three days after they had made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites learned that they were neighbors, living among them.
